description.sub_ename: INTERNATIONAL LOGISTICS AND NET ZERO IN SUSTAINABILITY
description.describe_ch: 本課程將深入探討國際物流管理的基本原理和實踐方法，並結合淨零永續的理念，探討如何在物流行業實現可持續發展。學生將學習到國際物流的核心環節，以及如何應用綠色物流策略來降低碳排放、提高經濟效益和環境效益。
description.describe_eh: This course delves into the fundamental principles and practical methods of international logistics management, integrating the concept of net zero sustainability to explore how to achieve sustainable development in the logistics industry. Students will learn about the core aspects of international logistics and how to apply green logistics strategies to reduce carbon emissions, improve economic and environmental benefits.

Depending on the course format, instructors will address classroom conduct, online etiquette, and student responsibilities. gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en: Students are kindly reminded to adhere to classroom rules and etiquette to ensure a productive and respectful learning environment. This course emphasizes the relationship between international logistics and net-zero sustainability, offering instruction on sustainability reporting and integrating global news and academic research to connect key concepts. Depending on the course format, instructors will address classroom conduct, online etiquette, and student responsibilities. Respecting these guidelines and attending class punctually are essential to fostering an inclusive atmosphere where all students can engage meaningfully and benefit from the full scope of the curriculum. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated in supporting a positive and academically enriching experience for everyone.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: Please conduct your course report through independent research and collaboration with your group members. The use of AI-generated content is strictly prohibited.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
Academic integrity encompasses the fundamental principles of honesty, trustworthiness, and fairness within the realm of education. Students are expected to demonstrate academic integrity throughout their learning journey, including assessments, classroom interactions, and post-course engagements. This entails submitting one's own work, accurately representing sources, and refraining from any form of cheating, plagiarism, or unauthorized collaboration.
In assessments, students should independently complete assignments and exams without resorting to unfair practices such as copying from others or using unauthorized materials. When interacting in the classroom, students should engage in discussions and group activities with honesty and respect for others' ideas. After the course concludes, academic integrity involves maintaining the knowledge and skills acquired, using them ethically in future academic and professional endeavors.
Failure to uphold academic integrity can lead to serious consequences, ranging from academic penalties to long-term reputational damage. Plagiarism and cheating not only undermine the value of education but also erode personal growth and development. Thus, it is imperative for students to adhere to the principles of academic integrity not only for their immediate success but also for their overall character development and contribution to the scholarly community.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Academic integrity is a foundational value in education, encompassing honesty, trust, and fairness throughout the learning journey. Students are expected to submit original work, cite sources accurately, and avoid cheating, plagiarism, or unauthorized collaboration. This applies not only during assessments—where independent completion is essential—but also in classroom interactions, where respectful and honest engagement fosters meaningful dialogue. Even after a course concludes, academic integrity continues through the ethical application of acquired knowledge and skills in future academic and professional contexts. As artificial intelligence tools become more integrated into learning, students must also uphold ethical standards in their use, including clearly acknowledging AI-assisted content, refraining from using AI to circumvent academic requirements, applying critical judgment to AI-generated suggestions, and respecting intellectual property rights. Violations of these principles can result in academic penalties and long-term reputational harm, undermining both educational value and personal growth. Therefore, maintaining academic integrity and responsible AI use is not only vital for immediate success but also for cultivating character and contributing to a trustworthy scholarly community.
